Description: Single-project preset with controllers, entity models, repository-based CRUD, SQL Server config, Swagger, and Windows authentication.

Instructions: Keep the project as a single API project with Controllers, Models, Repositories, Data, and Properties folders only.
Do not introduce DTO, request, response, service, or endpoint module layers for this preset.
Controllers should use repository abstractions directly and use the entity model as the request and response contract.
Keep SQL Server configuration in appsettings and preserve Windows authentication setup.
Use only the current profile, current file, and provided artifacts in the request.
Do not depend on hidden repository context or prior conversation memory.
